source.title: Ermes, Genadi, John, and Devon predict the Morozov vs Vitaly supermatch
source.description:
Ermes Gasparini, Genadi Kvikvinia, John Brzenk and Devon Larratt have given their opinions on the right-arm supermatch between Artyom Morozov and Vitaly Laletin, which will take place at the East vs West 13 event on July 6.
